style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, soft warm-grey page #F4F1EA and warm-white #F7F6F3 for benefit and spec screens, warm-white #F1EEE7 for the colorway row, deep navy #20304C only for the closing screen; dusty pink #E8A9A0 reserved as the accent for icons, chips and the closing CTA button
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-color feature and care icons in #2A2C31, solid rounded info tags and chips
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and fill card, soft natural contact shadows, no harsh speculars; 5500K natural daylight for lifestyle scenes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh sporty-casual women's footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft warm-grey page #F4F1EA, graphite text #2A2C31, deep navy component background #20304C and one dusty-pink accent #E8A9A0 reserved for icons, chips and the closing CTA button; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and fill card, soft natural contact shadows, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with vertical Chinese captions and thin divider lines; consistent thin-line single-color feature and care icons; clean high-end footwear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the pair always shown at a stable 3/4 hero scale, centered and grounded by contact shadows in fully framed compositions; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the pair shown as a matched left-right pair from a stable 3/4 hero angle, consistent scale and centering across the set, grounded by contact shadows, never covered by labels, captions or props
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm-grey paper #F4F1EA, smooth light grey-beige studio floor #E9E5DE, warm grey pavement #C9C4BC for the on-foot scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, vertical Chinese captions, thin divider lines; dusty pink #E8A9A0 only for icon and chip accents, never for body text
